texts: A lower PRISM score is not a risk factor for bloodstream infection in the paediatric ICU: B.
PRISM (Pediatric Risk of Mortality) scores how sick a child is; a higher score, not a lower one, goes with more infections.
Lower admission weight, exposure to blood products, prolonged mechanical ventilation and renal dysfunction all raise the risk, as do central lines left in for long.
In the picture, the prism casting only a pale, thin rainbow belongs to the child without broccoli in his river.
Memory hook: a pale rainbow, a clean river.
